name: historical_eras_by_birth_year_v1
description: Broad, editable historical eras for the inherited/acquired tie audit. Conventional birth-year boundaries are used only as an operational cohort definition: Ancient through 500 CE, Post-Classical 501-1500, Mid-Modern 1501-1800, and Contemporary from 1801. Bins are mutually exclusive and exhaustive for valid numeric birth years; missing birth years are reported separately and excluded from cohort hypothesis comparisons.
